coupling: The validation commit adds a non-template rvalue VariantView that returns a view into the caller-owned temporary for short variants and into an internal temporary only for overlong variants; its pre-build length validation prevents the overlong path from reaching LocaleBuilder::setVariant. The revert commit adds a forwarding template overload and removes that pre-build length validation. With only the revert edit, the template returns a reference to the still-live caller temporary. Only when both edits are present does overload resolution prefer the non-template rvalue overload, allowing the overlong path to return a dangling std::string_view to setVariant.
